name: Waltham Cross Playing Field Play Area and Skate Park
description: Playground with swings, roundabouts, a slide, rockers and a climbing frame, interactive play equipment, a DJ booth, an enclosed rebound kickabout court, a multi-use games area and a skate park, with pay and display parking.
